course: ENG102 is a valuable course in terms of developing core academic skills such as academic writing, research, and oral presentation. The course successfully introduces students some academic skills such as the logic of academic inquiry, argumentation, and source-based writing. Especially, the research project assignment is  helps students improve researching skills and understand how to build a coherent academic argument. While the learning outcomes are strong, the time demands of the project could be reconsidered or slightly reduced to create a more balanced workload. It requires too much work load. Also, end-of-course interviews seems inefficient to me. Since the instructors conducting the interviews may not have read the students’ written work beforehand, the interviews can feel disconnected from the actual content and effort reflected in the research project.

From a positive perspective, I believe this course serves as a valuable preparatory foundation, especially for students who are considering an academic career. The skills, discipline, and way of thinking developed throughout the course can be highly beneficial for those who aim to pursue academia. In my opinion, the more students engage with and internalize the content of this course, the more successful they are likely to be in their future academic lives.
On the other hand, the course may be challenging for students who do not plan to follow an academic path. In a demanding academic environment like Bilkent University, where students already have numerous assignments and responsibilities, the workload required by this course can sometimes feel overwhelming. As a result, it may be perceived as time-consuming, especially when students are trying to balance multiple courses simultaneously.
Overall, while the course is highly beneficial for academically oriented students, its intensity can be difficult to manage within a heavy course load.
